headline: Revenue keeps growing, profit eases versus last quarter
summary_short: ICE's Q2 revenue of $3,611M rose 10.7% y/y (but -1.5% q/q); diluted EPS of $1.69 was up 14.2% y/y though down 31.9% q/q from an unusually strong Q1.
summary_long: Revenue was $3,611M, +10.7% y/y but -1.5% q/q. Operating margin fell to 38.5%, down roughly 690bp q/q and 130bp y/y as operating income slid to $1,391M from $1,665M in Q1. Net income of $958M rose 12.6% y/y but fell 32.2% q/q from Q1's $1,413M; diluted EPS of $1.69 moved the same way (+14.2% y/y, -31.9% q/q). Cash rose to $1,067M (+23.6% q/q, +6.4% y/y); long-term debt was roughly flat q/q at $18,628M, up 7.3% y/y.
